map.将文本各行按倒序排列，可保留或去掉空行，用于反转清单、回放步骤与处理按时间倒序的: Reverses the order of all lines in the text, optionally keeping or dropping blank lines. Useful for reversing lists, replaying steps, and handling time-descending data, completed instantly and entirely in your browser.
map.倒序输出：把末行置顶、首行置底，适合日志从新到旧展示。: Descending output: move the last line to the top and the first to the bottom, ideal for showing logs newest first.
map.栈式回放：按后进先出查看列表。: Stack-style replay: view a list in last-in, first-out order.
map.数据翻转：配合排序做降序排列的替代方案。: Data reversal: an alternative way to produce a descending arrangement alongside sorting.
map.日志倒序看最新: Read the Newest Log Lines First
map.：粘贴 100 行日志，行反转后第 100 行（最新）变第 1 行，便于先看最近: : paste 100 log lines and after reversing, line 100 (the newest) becomes line 1, so you can review recent events first; the text inside each line is unchanged, only the order flips.
map.和文本反转区别？: How Does This Differ from Text Reversal?
map.文本反转把整段当一串字符倒序（含行内），本工具只颠倒行顺序、保留每行内容，更适合: Text reversal treats the whole block as one character string and reverses it including within lines, while this tool flips only the line order and keeps each line's content, which suits logs and lists.
map.空行也作为一行参与反转；若想忽略空行请先去空白。: Blank lines take part in the reversal as lines too; strip whitespace first if you want to ignore them.
